documents.governing_entity: Northbridge Synthetic Group as Borrower, for the IFRS consolidated Group
documents.date_or_amendment: Unsigned draft; no party has signed it and its terms may change before signing

citations.quote: Draft status: this synthetic restatement is an unsigned draft; no party has signed it, and its terms may change before signing.

documents.limitation: Selected draft terms only; security, guarantee, default, cure and voting terms are omitted

covenants.name: Maximum net leverage ratio
covenants.definition_text: Covenant Net Debt is Covenant Debt less Eligible Cash, where Covenant Debt is the Group's total debt at IFRS carrying value excluding finance and operating lease obligations (Clause 2.1 and Clause 2.2); Covenant EBITDA is the Group's reported EBITDA over the trailing twelve months ending on the test date, with no adjustments, add-backs or pro-forma changes (Clause 2.3)
covenants.test_formula: Covenant Net Debt divided by Covenant EBITDA, tested at each calendar quarter end
covenants.period_scope: Every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025; the December 31, 2025 test uses closing net debt and trailing twelve-month Covenant EBITDA on the Group perimeter

citations.quote: Covenant Debt means the Group's total debt at IFRS carrying value excluding both finance and operating lease obligations, with no other exclusions or pro-forma adjustments.

Covenant EBITDA means the Group's reported EBITDA: revenue less cost of sales less function-only operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization, over the trailing twelve months ending on the test date.
The Borrower shall maintain the ratio of Covenant Net Debt to Covenant EBITDA at not more than 4.00x, tested at every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025.

covenants.limitation: Perimeter is the IFRS consolidated Group; the underlying financial statements are unaudited

covenants.name: Maximum net leverage ratio
covenants.definition_text: Covenant Net Debt is Covenant Debt less Eligible Cash, where Covenant Debt is the Group's total debt at IFRS carrying value excluding finance and operating lease obligations (Clause 2.1 and Clause 2.2); Covenant EBITDA is the Group's reported EBITDA over the trailing twelve months ending on the test date, with no adjustments, add-backs or pro-forma changes (Clause 2.3)
covenants.test_formula: Covenant Net Debt divided by Covenant EBITDA, tested at each calendar quarter end
covenants.period_scope: Every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025; the December 31, 2025 test uses closing net debt and trailing twelve-month Covenant EBITDA on the Group perimeter

citations.quote: Covenant Debt means the Group's total debt at IFRS carrying value excluding both finance and operating lease obligations, with no other exclusions or pro-forma adjustments.

Covenant EBITDA means the Group's reported EBITDA: revenue less cost of sales less function-only operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization, over the trailing twelve months ending on the test date.
The Borrower shall maintain the ratio of Covenant Net Debt to Covenant EBITDA at not more than 4.00x, tested at every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025.

covenants.limitation: Perimeter is the IFRS consolidated Group; the underlying financial statements are unaudited
